items.label: Open EscalationRadar dashboard
items.description: Open the moderator dashboard for recent heated and chaotic threads.

items.label: Check thread heat
items.description: Score this discussion for escalation signals and apply the heated flair if needed.

items.label: Mark as heated
items.description: Apply the heated flair now, useful when a moderator wants to flag a thread manually.

items.label: Mark as chaotic
items.description: Apply the chaotic flair now for fast-moving back-and-forth threads.

geminiApiKey.label: Gemini API key
geminiApiKey.helpText: Secret API key used for Gemini thread heat classification.

enabled.label: Enable automatic heat detection
enabled.helpText: When enabled, EscalationRadar scores new comments and flags heated posts automatically.

heatThreshold.label: Heat threshold
heatThreshold.helpText: Minimum score required before the app applies the heated flair. Higher values are less sensitive.

sampleSize.label: Recent comments to inspect
sampleSize.helpText: How many recent comments EscalationRadar should inspect per post.

lookbackMinutes.label: Lookback window in minutes
lookbackMinutes.helpText: Only comments newer than this window contribute to the heat score.

flairText.label: Heated flair text
flairText.helpText: The post flair text applied when a thread crosses the heat threshold.

chaoticFlairText.label: Chaotic flair text
chaoticFlairText.helpText: The post flair text applied when a thread is dominated by rapid back-and-forth comments.

chaoticThreshold.label: Chaotic threshold
chaoticThreshold.helpText: Minimum score required before the app applies the chaotic flair.

chaoticCommentThreshold.label: Chaotic comment threshold
chaoticCommentThreshold.helpText: Recent comment count that contributes to chaotic thread detection.

chaoticReplyThreshold.label: Chaotic reply threshold
chaoticReplyThreshold.helpText: Number of direct replies between the same two users that contributes to chaotic thread detection.

autoCreateFlair.label: Create reusable flair template
autoCreateFlair.helpText: When possible, create or reuse a mod-only post flair template during install and detection.

useGemini.label: Use Gemini classifier
useGemini.helpText: Use Gemini as a second-stage classifier before automatically flagging heated posts.

sendAllToGemini.label: Send every comment to Gemini
sendAllToGemini.helpText: Bypass the heuristic gate and ask Gemini to classify every new comment event.

geminiModel.label: Gemini model
geminiModel.helpText: Gemini model used for heat classification.
